operations.retry: Reconcile first; another logical request cannot overtake pending intent.
Reads can repeat. Nonmembership requires the complete preceding epoch anchored in the current root.
Identical original bytes only, at most three total transport calls.
Persisted results can be republished. Started or uncertain code is never automatically re-executed.
Uses the same nonce coordinator. No automatic heartbeat thread.
Idempotent local inhibition; does not cancel in-flight execution or revoke consensus authority.

errors.BUSY: Another local caller holds the identity or execution lock; use bounded scheduling.
errors.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Preserve pending bytes and reconcile; do not invent a replacement request.
errors.STALE: Stop dispatch and restore a current own-node observation.
errors.NOT_READY: Require fresh running observations with committed-height progress.
errors.FENCE: Retain evidence and inspect current ownership; do not execute under another fence.
errors.LIMIT: Do not reset counters to retry; reconcile the original operation.
errors.RETIRED_REQUEST: The closed epoch cannot admit this original request.
errors.STOPPED: Local emergency inhibition is latched; operator-controlled restart must warm readiness again.
